name: Camera and microphone indicators
plain: A dot or chip that shows the camera or mic is active.
meaning: Warns the user in real time. Android 12 shows a green chip; iOS 14 shows green and orange dots.

android.prompt_ui: Green chip in status bar; tap for app name
android.note: Android 12 only camera and mic have indicators.

ios.prompt_ui: Green dot for camera, orange dot for mic; Control Center shows recent access

limits.headline: Can't use the camera or mic without a dot or chip showing
limits.user_action: Nothing. The dot or chip shows when an app uses the camera or microphone
can: Show a green chip for the camera on Android 12 and later; tap it for the app name
Show a green dot for the camera and orange dot for the mic on iPhone (iOS 14)
Show recent access in Control Center on iPhone
cannot: Hide the dot, since the system draws it
Cover location or other sensors on Android 12; the dot is for the camera and mic only
limits.differs: Android 12 and later uses a green chip. iPhone (iOS 14 and later) uses green and orange dots.

story.what_it_is: A dot or chip on the screen that shows when the camera or microphone is on.

marketing.name: Recording indicators
marketing.pitch: A green or orange dot shows when an app uses your camera or microphone.

marketing.name: Privacy indicators
marketing.pitch: Android 12 shows icons in the status bar when apps use the camera or mic.

story.for_you: You see a small green or orange dot in a corner. Tap Control Center or the chip to learn which app is using the camera or mic.
story.for_makers: Apps cannot hide it, so makers must be careful. Turning on the camera for no clear reason leads to angry reviews, so teams keep camera use short and clear.

use_cases.example: A video call app turns on the green dot only while you are in a call.
A camera effect app shows the dot while you preview and removes it when you leave.
An AR game shows the dot while the camera feeds the scene.
A user sees an orange dot at 2 a.m. and finds an app listening in the background.
A baby monitor app shows the dot while it streams the nursery.
A company checks that screen sharing apps never show the dot unexpectedly.

story.android_note: Android 12 shows a green chip in the status bar.
story.ios_note: iOS 14 and later shows green for camera and orange for microphone.
